notes: Access: direct fetch, no WAF/blocking encountered; robots.txt (checked first) has no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow, only standard Shopify admin/checkout/search/policy exclusions (Sitemap: https://www.nkuku.com/sitemap.xml). Shopify store (myshopify id 5782274146 visible in robots.txt). Nav tree sourced from the site's mega-menu (desktop mega-menu__link--parent columns cross-checked against the mobile HeaderDrawer-* menu-drawer markup in the homepage HTML) rather than the raw /collections.json dump, which lists 774 handles, most of them marketing/product-line collections (e.g. 'Aamani Furniture', per-SKU-family collections) that are not real nav categories and were excluded. Qty verification (Rule 1): every leaf qty is a paged /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250) exhaustion count of unique product IDs, run via probe.py's shopify_count. This was spot-checked against the rendered 'See N items' header on 3 live collection pages (wall-mirrors, mugs, candleholders) and matched exactly in all 3. The raw /collections.json products_count field is confirmed INFLATED here (consistent with the project-wide finding): e.g. mugs raw=93 vs verified=44, table-lamps raw=84 vs verified=49, candleholders raw=133 vs verified=77, pendant-lighting raw=95 vs verified=63 -- the verified/exhausted number was used throughout, never the raw field. Excluded: the entire Furniture/Sofas/Garden-furniture tree (armchairs, tables, storage/cabinets, beds, benches, stools); Soft Furnishings (cushions, blankets & throws), Bedroom Textiles, Rugs/Runners/Doormats (all textiles); Jewellery (necklaces, bracelets, earrings, rings, jewellery boxes); the Gifting nav (Gifts under GBP50/100/250, Gifts for Her/Him/etc, Bestselling Gifts -- promo/recipient cuts, not categories); Home Fragrance column (Reed Diffusers, and 'Candles' handle=candles which sample-checked as scented: 'Oakmoss & Rose 1 Wick Scented Candle', 'Sea Salt & Moss ... Scented Candle', product_type='CANDLES & HOME FRAGRANCE' -- dropped per the Candles-node rule; the unscented holder collections Candlesticks/Lanterns/Candle Holders were sample-checked as plain holders (product_type='CANDLES HOLDERS & LANTERNS') and kept); Christmas Decorations column entirely (baubles, tree toppers, wreaths, stockings); kitchen tools/cutlery/bar tools (Cutlery, Chopping Boards, Cheese Board & Knives, Serving Cutlery, Barware Accessories, Breakfast Accessories); kitchen/pantry storage (Storage Jars, Kitchen Storage, Pantry, Wine Racks); Table Settings & Linens and 'All Table Accessories' (textile-heavy mixed rollup); Bathroom column apart from lighting -- Bathroom Accessories sample-checked as 'Amandi Rattan Laundry Bin', 'Amandi Toilet Roll Holder', 'Aniko Iron Ceiling Hook' (product_type='STORAGE') so dropped as bathroom hardware/storage, likewise Soap Dishes/Soap Dispensers/Laundry Baskets; Fireside sample-checked as a mixed rollup of log baskets/coal buckets (product_type='STORAGE', excluded) plus lanterns (already captured separately) so dropped whole per the mixed-rollup rule. Rule 0 gains (room word present but product type in scope, included): Outdoor Lighting (qty 12), Bathroom Lighting (qty 6, its own single-item mega-menu column), Garden Planters (qty 28) and Garden Decor & Accessories (qty 39, sample-checked as planters + tealight holders, genuinely decorative). Rule 0.6 overlaps documented (same handle/URL reached from >1 nav path, counted once): 'Decorative Hooks & Rails' (handle decorative-hooks) is linked identically from the Kitchen&Dining>Pantry&Storage column, the Bathroom column, and the Storage&Utility column; 'Decorative Pots & Vases' (handle decorative-pots-vases) is linked from both the Decorative Accessories column and the Vases&Planters column; 'Garden Decor & Accessories' (handle garden-decor-accessories) is linked from both the Garden furniture nav and the Decorative Accessories column; 'Outdoor Lighting' (handle outdoor-lighting) is linked from both the Lighting menu and the Garden nav's 'Garden Lighting' label. Separately, 'Bowls' (general tableware, qty 28) and 'Serving Bowls' (serveware, qty 25) are two genuinely distinct nav branches with different handles/counts -- both kept per Rule 0.6, not treated as a facet re-cut.
